![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM0MTQxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7f34914b5332590a45179b151b57aff31bc93690/Logo%20Sendero%20Tijuana%202025%20(1).png)
**¡Bienvenidos a “Sendero Tijuana 2025”!**
Nos alegra presentar la **tercera competencia oficial totalmente gratuita en la ciudad de Tijuana**, reafirmando el compromiso de seguir acercando el speedcubing a más jóvenes y familias en Baja California.  
Este evento busca fomentar un ambiente de sana competitividad y aprendizaje, ofreciendo a los nuevos competidores la oportunidad perfecta para vivir su primera experiencia en una competencia avalada por la WCA.

*Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento de la WCA ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)antes de la competencia.*

**Welcome to “Sendero Tijuana 2025”!**
We are proud to present the **third official competition completely free of charge in the city of Tijuana**, continuing our commitment to bringing speedcubing closer to more youth and families in Baja California.  
This event aims to foster an environment of healthy competition and learning, offering new competitors the perfect opportunity to experience their very first WCA official competition.

*This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.*

items.information:
Välkomna till Norrlandsmästerskapet 2025! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Norrland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Norrlandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Norrlandsmasterskapet2025#60533-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)".

-----

Welcome to Norrlandsmästerskapet 2025!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. items.name: Utah Championship 2025
items.information:
This is the State Championship for Utah. To be recognized as the Utah Champion, please register your state of residence on [CubingUSA!](https://cubingusa.org/) Anyone may register for the competition but only Utah Residents are eligible for the Utah Champion title.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the [Registration and Waistlist Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahChampionship2023#30564-registration-and-waitlist-info) tab. 

Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBblkvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--78136ba2316603f64144b1e4187349c9f12b5dd9/image.png)](https://utahcubing.org)

items.name: Five Blind in Tashkent Phase One - Denial - 2025
items.information:
**English**

This is the Stage 1 of the series.

The competitor limit for this competition is 10 participants.

Foreign competitors are kindly requested to contact the delegate by email before purchasing tickets to travel to Uzbekistan. After your registration is confirmed, you will be asked to provide the copy of your ticket in order to make sure that you will participate in the competition.

**Russian**

Это первая стадия серии.

Лимит на количество участников - 10 человек.

Просьба к участникам из других стран - перед приобретением билетов для поездки в Узбекистан свяжитесь с делегатом. После подтверждения вашей регистрации мы попросим вас предоставить копию вашего билета, чтобы быть уверенными, что вы примете участие в соревнованиях.
